notes.title: Check out our latest demo during Steam Next Fest!
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45469074/15f70c8572589e96623dfa799f1d06dfd4051c5e.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]Eggstraordinary Goose Chase Demo Now Live on Desktop & Steam Deck![/b][/h3][p][/p][p]We’re thrilled to share that the [b]latest demo for Eggstraordinary Goose Chase[/b] is now available for everyone to try out — on both [b]PC and Steam Deck[/b]![/p][p][/p][p]💫 [b]What’s in the Demo?[/b]
Enjoy [b]11 handpicked levels from Chapter 1[/b], packed with action and surprises.[/p][p][/p][p]🌀 Sprint through vibrant stages, dodge obstacles, collect berries, stomp enemies, and take bold risks. Keep running, push your limits, and reclaim what’s yours![/p][p][/p][p]After trying the demo, we’d love to hear from you!
Tell us what you enjoyed, what you’d like to see refined, or if you ran into any sneaky bugs.[/p][p]👉 [b][url="https://steamcommunity.com/app/3381470/discussions/0/595151378385475466/"]Leave your feedback here[/url][/b][/p][p]Your feedback helps us shape the future of the game — thank you in advance for taking the time to share![/p]
